rebuildComment: 'npm run rebuild -- sc.defiance.red' prepares 'export' into 'source' (shrinks the textures), stands it on y = 0 at 'height' tall (the export is 1.75 tall) and rigs it. The export is already low-poly (15.8k triangles), so there is no reduce step.
comment: Coordinates are in model units after the rescale: x = character's left, y = up (feet at 0), z = forward. Bones marked mirror are copied to the right side with x negated. Measured with scripts/measure-glb.mjs on sc.defiance.red.prepared.glb. Two objects: defiance.red.body (armour, T-pose, one fused surface) and defiance.red.head (the helmet, one fused surface).
relaxedArmsComment: Where the arms rest while the body tracker does not see them (left arm; the right is mirrored). Held a little out so the forearm armour clears the hip plates.
keepComment: 'keep': the bone only takes points on one side of a plane (normal . point >= offset). The arm bones stop at a line from the armpit (x 0.26, y 1.68) up and in to x 0.2 at y 1.95, so the shoulder pad follows the arm and the side of the chest does not. The shoulder bone (shrug) only takes the top of the shoulder, outside a line from (x 0.2, y 1.72) up and in to (x 0.1, y 1.9), so a shrug does not lift the chest plates. 'smooth' on hips / spine / chest / shoulder: one smoothing pass instead of three, so arm movement does not spread into the chest plates.
partsComment: The helmet is rigid: the whole head object is fixed to the head bone. There is no jaw, no mouth and no expression shapes (the face is a mask).
webcamHeadComment: The operator's own head, cut out of the webcam picture, can take the helmet's place: the 'Helmet' button or the V key in the app. 'hide' = the objects that are swapped out (the helmet). 'scale' = size of the webcam head (1 = a head that would fit in the helmet). 'offset' moves it from the helmet's centre [left, up, forward]. 'contrast' = contrast of the webcam picture (1 = as the camera gives it). Run 'npm run rig -- sc.defiance.red' after changing these.
